allowlisted_destination.description: the destination is on this workspace's allowlist

reversible_action.description: this action can be undone locally

confidence._comment: How sure we are, deliberately separate from how bad. High score with low confidence must never block.

thresholds._comment: Score cutoffs for the intervention ladder. Climbed, not jumped.
thresholds._comment_confidence: Confidence gates: below these, the ladder is capped. High score + low confidence NOTIFYs, it does not block.

irreversible._comment: Only irreversible actions may reach PAUSE or BLOCK. A file write in a clean git tree is reversible and must not be blocked.

interaction._comment_headless: What to do when no human is reachable. A judgment about what is safe when nobody is watching, so it lives here and not in the adapter.
